hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[;&|(]\\s*)(uv|qmd|pytest|ruff|python3?)\\b") and (test("direnv export") | not) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",updatedInput:(.tool_input | .command = "eval \"$(direnv export bash 2>/dev/null)\"; " + .command)}} else empty end'
